name: sigrank-hf-hackathon
description: SigRank — HuggingFace hackathon prototype (Thousand Token Wood track, MiniCPM4-0.5B). The concept proof that became signalaf.com. Live product is now github.com/SunrisesIllNeverSee/sigrank-app.

paragraphs: A leaderboard that judges AI coding operators by architecture, not budget. Paste your token usage; get an operator profile with a tiny-model narration and your rank. The ranking metric Υ = (cacheread · output) / input² (here "Cache" = cacheread) penalizes raw-input padding quadratically — volume can't buy rank — but Υ is only the headline of a larger metric system whose mathematical thesis is the cascade decomposition.
GitHub: github.com/SunrisesIllNeverSee · Repo: moses-sigrank · Deck: mos2es.com/deck · Benchmarks: mos2es.com/benchmarks · Law: mos2es.com

SigRank is Layer 2 of the MO§ES™ stack — the human–AI operator intelligence layer. MO§ES™ is the substrate: compression, recursive execution, drift control, governed meaning at source.
